WITH graph(node, label) AS (
  VALUES
    ('understand','理解需求'), ('plan','规划'), ('search','查询'),
    ('policy','差标'), ('approval','审批'), ('confirm','确认'),
    ('book','下单'), ('respond','回复')
), ordered AS (
  SELECT replace(name, 'orchestration.node.', '') AS node,
         status, duration_ms, start_time,
         lag(replace(name, 'orchestration.node.', ''))
           OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS prev
  FROM spans
  WHERE trace_id = '$trace_id'
    AND name LIKE 'orchestration.node.%'
), marked AS (
  SELECT *,
         sum(CASE WHEN node IS DISTINCT FROM prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS grp
  FROM ordered
), dedup AS (
  SELECT grp,
         (array_agg(node ORDER BY start_time))[1] AS node,
         (array_agg(status ORDER BY start_time))[1] AS status,
         (array_agg(duration_ms ORDER BY start_time))[1] AS duration_ms,
         min(start_time) AS start_time
  FROM marked
  GROUP BY grp
)
SELECT d.node AS id,
       g.label AS title,
       d.status AS subtitle,
       d.duration_ms AS mainstat,
       CASE WHEN d.status = 'error' THEN 'red' ELSE 'green' END AS color,
       d.start_time AS detail__start_time
FROM dedup d JOIN graph g ON g.node = d.node
ORDER BY d.start_time;

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT replace(name, 'orchestration.node.', '') AS node,
         start_time,
         lag(replace(name, 'orchestration.node.', ''))
           OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS prev
  FROM spans
  WHERE trace_id = '$trace_id'
    AND name LIKE 'orchestration.node.%'
), marked AS (
  SELECT *,
         sum(CASE WHEN node IS DISTINCT FROM prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS grp
  FROM ordered
), dedup AS (
  SELECT grp,
         (array_agg(node ORDER BY start_time))[1] AS node,
         min(start_time) AS start_time
  FROM marked
  GROUP BY grp
), seq AS (
  SELECT node, lag(node) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS prev
  FROM dedup
)
SELECT prev || ' -> ' || node AS id,
       prev AS source,
       node AS target,
       1 AS mainstat
FROM seq
WHERE prev IS NOT NULL;

SELECT task_id, status,
       min(start_time) AS started_at,
       max(start_time) AS last_span,
       count(*) AS node_spans
FROM spans
WHERE trace_id = '$trace_id'
  AND name LIKE 'orchestration.node.%'
GROUP BY task_id, status
ORDER BY started_at;
